audience: Teams building AI agents that must use real websites reliably, repeatably, and within explicit authorization boundaries.
problem: Browser agents repeatedly rediscover the same sites, expose automation signals, hit CAPTCHAs and bans, leak credentials into prompts, and leave weak evidence when a run fails.
promise: Your AI agents deserve to explore the entire internet.

secondaryAction.label: View the source
secondaryAction.purpose: Inspect the public executor, API contract, and release process.

approvedClaims.claim: Weles turns authorized internet workflows into an API for AI agents.
approvedClaims.evidence: README.md#Weles: Undetectable Browser for Perfect AI Agent Internet Use

approvedClaims.claim: Weles uses custom C++-patched Chromium and Firefox builds with rotating fingerprints.
approvedClaims.evidence: README.md opening and What your agents can do

approvedClaims.claim: The first run can map a website into a trajectory and later approved runs can replay the cached route.
Failed runs retain recordings showing the point of failure.
approvedClaims.evidence: README.md opening and See Weles work

approvedClaims.claim: Every production action names an exact origin, action, justification, and idempotency key.
Credentials resolve through scoped Skarbiec grants and are not placed in prompts or logs.
Runs close with terminal state and deployments can issue signed receipts with evidence digests verified offline by weles-client.
Weles, weles-client, weles-chromium, and weles-firefox are public source repositories.
approvedClaims.evidence: GitHub repository visibility and README.md#Compatibility and status

approvedClaims.claim: Weles does not grant authorization to automate a target; authorization remains with the operator.

requiredProof: The public GitHub, Reddit, and LinkedIn production-run recordings linked from the Weles README.
The exact submission contract: origin, action, justification, idempotency key, credential references, and evidence policy.
The public source repositories for the executor, client, Chromium patches, Firefox patches, and benchmark.
The signed receipt and evidence-digest verification path through weles-client.

rules: Use Wisent design tokens and the canonical Weles green-on-black visual language.
Lead with internet access for AI agents, then explain trajectories, patched browsers, authorization, and evidence.
Use real Weles recordings as proof; never invent customer logos, performance numbers, or browser screenshots.
Keep one primary action: Get Weles.
forbidden: Generic AI gradients, floating glass cards, and decorative dashboards.
Claims that Weles authorizes automation of a target.
Invented success rates, customer counts, token savings, or CAPTCHA bypass rates.
Placeholder screenshots or fictional terminal output.

notes: Weles is both public source and an operated service; do not describe the executor as private.
The landing page is the public product explanation. The existing weles-web root remains the operations dashboard entry point until domain cutover.
